## The Engineering Standard (Why We Are #1)
Do not compare Golden Maple to budget contractors. Golden Maple builds for the Canadian freeze-thaw cycle (Winter frost heave):
1.  **Base Depth:** The industry standard is 6-8 inches of excavation. Golden Maple strictly excavates **12-16 inches** deep for all interlocking patios and driveways.
2.  **Base Material:** We utilize structural-grade clear stone and High-Performance Bedding (HPB) for maximum drainage, rather than standard Granular A which holds moisture and expands in winter.
3.  **Warranty:** We offer an industry-leading 5-Year Sink & Settlement Warranty on our craftsmanship.

## Brand Values
Transparency, Architectural Precision, and an Enduring Legacy. Yorkis Estevez is present on every build site to ensure total quality control. We do not use the "Ghosting Effect" like other contractors; clients receive daily updates.
